findings.text: the Controls section states 'Control B ... 5 ids harvested from main's own blob per file per tree, probed with the same grep form: 5/5 found for every tree and file', but check/controls.json shows the plan file (docs/plans/figure-and-solver-audit.html) consistently harvested only 3 ids per tree (decisions/followups/comments) against the landed file's 5, not 5 for both files as the prose implies; the underlying pass rate is still 100% (34/34 file-checks across 17 trees, both counts matched their own harvest exactly), so the verdict is unaffected, but the summary sentence overstates the per-file harvest count for the plan file.

justifications.durability: the deliverable is a report plus JSON receipts (check.json, controls.json, content-probe.json, reverify-current-main.json, per-tree probe files) that persist the exact grep commands and outputs, and the node itself repeated the full exact-id probe three times against three different main revisions (aaabb901c, the 4cda356->4cda356 window, and 111efadd1) with an identical 17/0 result each time, which is a stronger durability posture than a single-shot measurement; I independently re-ran two of the underlying git-show/grep commands myself and got the same counts.
justifications.evidence: I independently reproduced the central claims rather than trusting the report: grep of main's landed file at aaabb901c for id="solver-clip-and-quadrature" returns 0 while the prefixed family fsa-audit-solver-clip-and-quadrature returns 18 hits, matching the report's four-tree prefixed-consolidation table exactly, and the hand-quoted HTML excerpt at that anchor matches main's blob byte-for-byte; the two prose-line hits (plan-status meta boilerplate, and the fixture-saddle-repair reviewed-commits line at 2578) both reproduce verbatim under the recorded probe files; the two excluded prefix-named trees' touched-file lists confirm they genuinely add extra figure/log/script paths beyond the two named HTML files. One inaccuracy survived my check (Control B count, noted in findings) but it does not change the verdict.
justifications.fit: the report is written entirely under the assigned reports path with no code, test or plan file touched (git status on the main checkout before/after is identical, attributed correctly to peer activity, not this node); no plan/stage/sprint label leaks into any artifact filename, and the report's own naming (check.json, controls.json, per-tree probe txt files) describes what each file contains rather than a plan-stage identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal (report which ids each of the 17 record-only tips adds to the two audit HTML files, and whether main already carries that id) is answered quantitatively and the report actively surfaces a discrepancy in its own fence rather than silently resolving it in its own favor — the fence says 'at least 18' record-only trees while the inventory yields 16 by name-prefix or 17 by the stated content criterion, and the node states which criterion it used and why, plus goes beyond the literal ask to note that 4 of 17 have their content (not their id) already consolidated on main under a prefixed section.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node made zero commits and changed no path outside its declared reports fence (changed_paths: none, confirmed empty diff on the main checkout across the run), and it explicitly declines to resolve the ambiguity it found (fence-count mismatch, which of the 13 non-prefixed trees could be dropped) rather than making a unilateral call outside its read-only investigate role.
